changeSet.comment: Ensure the Self Service User role has the ACCOUNTTRANSFER CREATE permission required by the refactored transfer endpoints.

changeSet.author: fineract

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM m_role WHERE name = 'Self Service User'

changeSet.comment: Grant ACCOUNTTRANSFER CREATE to the Self Service User role if not already granted.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO m_role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT r.id, p.id FROM m_role r CROSS JOIN m_permission p WHERE r.name = 'Self Service User' AND p.code = 'CREATE_ACCOUNTTRANSFER' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_role_permission rp WHERE rp.role_id = r.id AND rp.permission_id = p.id );
